title: Vikram and Betal: The Wise Merchant

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a wise merchant.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a merchant known for his wisdom.

scenes.summary: Two men claim the same bag of money.
scenes.text: Two men argued over who owned a bag of money.
scenes.image_prompt: two men arguing over money bag cartoon

scenes.text: The merchant kept the bag and checked it carefully.
scenes.image_prompt: merchant opening bag and reading note cartoon

scenes.text: He asked both men what was inside the bag.
The merchant gave the bag to the honest man. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: Two men claimed a bag of money. A wise merchant investigated and asked questions to find the truth. He gave the bag to the rightful owner. Vikram said wisdom and patience lead to the right decision.
